pages.quiz:
ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 8 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 8
   C. 7
   D. 14

2. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 40

3. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 18

4. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 3
   C. 40
   D. 41

5. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 3, 6, 9
   B. 2, 4, 6
   C. 1, 2, 3, 6
   D. 1, 6

6. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 1
   C. 73
   D. 72

7. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 9
   D. 81

8. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/2
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

9. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.6
   C. 29
   D. 23.7

10. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x

11. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 75
   C. 30
   D. 40

12. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 17
   C. 21
   D. 3

13. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 24

14. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 57
   C. 56
   D. 1

15. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 12
   C. 33
   D. 4

16. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 43

17. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 42
   C. 12
   D. 24

18. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 31
   C. 1
   D. 1

19. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 8
   C. 24.5
   D. 49

20. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 55
   C. 16
   D. 22

21. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 37

22. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

23. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 10

24. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 1

25. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 32
   C. 33
   D. 12

26. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 33
   C. 27
   D. 27.7

27. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 2

28. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 13
   C. 7
   D. 12

29. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.7
   C. 25
   D. 19.6

30. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 21
   C. 15.6
   D. 15.7

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
